description: Use when you want the stocks that share a stock's subsector ETF or sector ETF. Not for cohort-level residual statistics (use riskmodels_get_cohorts). Returns, from GET /peers, the peer list ordered by market cap with each peer's market cap. End-of-day data, refreshed after each US market close. Price: $0.005 per call.

ticker.description: US stock ticker symbol, case-insensitive, e.g. NVDA
